HJR271
7BLBZV2-3
By Representative Jackson
RFD: Rules
First Read: 19-Mar-26
Enrolled, An Act,
NAMING THE PORTION OF ALABAMA HIGHWAY 21 FROM MILE MARKER 39
TO MILE MARKER 41 IN MONROE COUNTY THE SPECIAL AGENT JUSTIN
WILLIAMS MEMORIAL HIGHWAY.
WHEREAS, it is with the highest accolade that this
body honors Special Agent Justin Jemel Williams by
requesting the State Department of Transportation designate
the portion of Alabama Highway 21 from mile marker 39 to
mile marker 41 in Monroe County, Alabama, the Special Agent
Justin Williams Memorial Highway; and
WHEREAS, Special Agent Williams distinguished himself
in the Highway Patrol Division of the Alabama State Law
Enforcement Agency (ALEA); after three years with the State
Troopers, he was advanced to the Major Crimes Division in
the ABI/SBI branch of ALEA, serving five years with that
agency and tackling complex criminal investigations; he was
assigned to the United States Marshals Fugitive Apprehension
Task Force, showcasing his ability to collaborate on a
national level; he then served six years in protective
services, serving on the protective details of both Governor
Robert Bentley and Governor Kay Ivey, where he further
distinguished himself in a role that required a high level
of skill to manage often high-stress situations; and
WHEREAS, Special Agent Williams' dedication to law
enforcement is evident in his advancement during his 19
years of service to the State of Alabama, particularly by
continuing to serve on Governor Ivey's protection detail
while receiving treatments to battle his cancer diagnosis;
he was also a man of steadfast faith and a dedicated father,
son, and brother; he was a truly special person who spread
joy to everyone around him; his work leaves a lasting impact
on the people he protected and served with honor, merit, and
excellence; now therefore,
BE IT RESOLVED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF ALABAMA, BOTH
HOUSES THEREOF CONCURRING, That to honor Special Agent
Justin Jemel Williams for his law enforcement service and
lasting positive impact to the safety of Monroe County and
its residents and the State of Alabama, the State Department
of Transportation is encouraged to coordinate with local
governing officials to consider designating the portion of
Alabama Highway 21 from mile marker 39 to mile marker 41 in
Monroe County the Special Agent Justin Williams Memorial
Highway and to erect appropriate signs or markers,
consistent with applicable requirements and laws, in
recognition of this designation.
